intro: Protect the Frontier is an Alliance assignment handed out by Guard Thomas at the eastern bridge crossing in Elwynn Forest. As Stormwind's military presence thins toward the border, wild predators have grown increasingly bold, harassing travelers and workers at the Eastvale Logging Camp. Guard Thomas seeks capable adventurers to cull the wolves and bears threatening the eastern frontier.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hail, friend. Wild animals are growing more and more aggressive the farther we get from Goldshire, and the Eastvale Logging Camp suffers nearly constant attacks from wolves and bears!
We could use your help out here.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you killed those wolves and bears?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thanks a lot for the help, friend. Something in the forest must be making these animals so bold.
Whatever it is, I hope it stays there.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
